title: Plugin record
description: Creation-time record for one OBS Studio plugin packaged as a snap. This is the single source of truth: scripts/generate.py projects each record into repos/<snap_name>.tfvars, and the record itself is passed to copier (JSON is valid YAML) together with the .description.md sidecar. Hand-edit the record and the optional sidecar; never edit generated files. The record file must be named <plugin_name>-obs-studio.json: the plugin name is derived by stripping the -obs-studio suffix.

source_url.description: Where the plugin source comes from: upstream Git repository (with optional .git suffix). Feeds the snap's 'source' field and the copier template's source_url question. Optional: redistributable runtimes (e.g. proprietary SDKs fetched at build time) have no upstream source URL and omit it.

website.description: Public-facing page shown as the snap's 'website' in the store listing: project homepage, OBS forums thread, or custom site. For source-hosted plugins it usually equals source_url with the .git suffix stripped; when omitted, the copier template applies that default from source_url. Required for source-less packages (enforced below).

summary.description: One-line summary. Used as the snap's 'summary', the GitHub repository description, and the README headline.

license.description: SPDX license identifier of the plugin (e.g. GPL-2.0, MIT). Use 'Proprietary' for non-free runtime libraries.

title.description: Optional override for the snap's 'title' field. Defaults to '{plugin_name} (OBS plugin)' with dashes replaced by spaces and words capitalized; set it when that casing is wrong (e.g. acronyms like DistroAV).
